definitions.full: H8472. Tachpenes תַּחְמְּנֵיס proper name, feminine Egyptian queen ; — 1Kin 11:19-20 , נֵס - 11:20 ; Θεκ[χ]εμεινα .

occurrences.englishText: Hadad found great favor in the sight of Pharaoh, so that he gave him as wife the sister of his own wife, the sister of Tahpenes the queen.
The sister of Tahpenes bore him Genubath his son, whom Tahpenes weaned in Pharaoh’s house; and Genubath was in Pharaoh’s house among the sons of Pharaoh.
